title: Captured-SynchronizationContext PropertyChanged dispatch
body: PLAN-ROMM-001. LibraryObservableObject posts PropertyChanged off-context to the captured UI SynchronizationContext and raises inline when already on-context, preventing RPC_E_WRONG_THREAD in UWP XAML binding. Verified by LibraryObservableObjectTests.Dispatch (covers AC-BROWSE-08).
